source_unit.source_text:
<STRUCT_0001>
In this Chapter, we discuss <ACCENT_0001>tale morphisms of schemes. We illustrate
some of the more important concepts by working with the Noetherian case.
Our principal goal is to collect for the reader enough commutative
algebra results to start reading a treatise on <ACCENT_0002>tale cohomology. An
auxiliary goal is to provide enough evidence to ensure that the reader stops
calling the phrase ``the <ACCENT_0003>tale topology of schemes'' an exercise in general
nonsense, if (s)he does indulge in such blasphemy.
